n.story:
Your role is transitioning from a manual operator to a high-tech industrial conductor. While the core of your work remains grounded in the physical heat and pressure of the forge, AI is stripping away the repetitive 'grunt work' of loading, unloading, and constant temperature monitoring. Instead of manually adjusting valves, you will spend your time interpreting complex diagnostic data provided by AI-driven digital twins of your machinery.

As sensors take over the mundane task of spotting defective workpieces, your expertise will shift toward high-level troubleshooting and process optimization. You will use AI to predict how different alloys will react under specific pressures, allowing you to refine forging patterns for maximum material integrity. You are no longer just a pair of hands on the tongs; you are the critical human link that manages the sophisticated interplay between automated systems and the physical realities of metal fabrication.
